verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਰਤਨੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਨੇਰੁ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: rovai ratan gavai kai maiaa moh aner gubaaraa|

en.bdb: Losing the jewel (in the form of the name of the Lord) the creature (on his birth) wails and weeps in utter darkness of maya and infatuation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: oh rovai dhukh aapanaa has has gaavai sabh paravaaraa|

en.bdb: He cries because of his own suffering but the whole family sings merrily.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆਂ ਰੁਣ ਝੁੰਝਨੜਾ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabhanaa(n) man vaadhaieeaa(n) run jhu(n)jhanaRaa run jhunakaaraa|

en.bdb: The heart of all is full of happiness and musical sound of drums is heard all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਦਕੁ ਸੋਹਲੇ ਦੇਨਿ ਅਸੀਸਾਂ ਬਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: naanak dhaadhak sohale dhen aseesaa(n) baal piaaraa|

en.bdb: Singing songs of happiness maternal and paternal families bless the beloved child.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੁਖਹੁਂ ਬਿੰਦਕ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਿੰਦਹੁਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਪਰਬਤ ਭਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: chukhahu(n) bi(n)dhak bi(n)dh kar bi(n)dhahu(n) keetaa parabat bhaaraa|

en.bdb: From a small drop it increased and now that drop looks like a mountain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸੁਗਰਥ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath sugarath visaar visaaraa|

en.bdb: Having grown up, he has with pride forgotten the truth, contentment, compassion, dharma and higher values.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaam karodh virodh vich lobh moh dhroh aha(n)kaaraa|

en.bdb: He started living among desires, anger, oppositions, greed, infatuation, treachery and pride,
And thus the poor fellow got entangled in the larg web of maya..
